cohort: The study included 55 term neonates with perinatal asphyxia (defined as umbilical cord arterial pH <7.0 and/or base excess >=12 mmol/L) and 55 healthy term neonates (with umbilical cord arterial pH >7.2).
finding: HNNE scores at discharge were significantly lower among term neonates with perinatal asphyxia compared to healthy neonates, showing a good correlation with umbilical cord arterial pH but no association with standard base excess.
